mentions.name: Eurotrucker smart-bike mod
mentions.description: A half-built Euro Truck Simulator mod that uses the smart exercise bike as a control interface, started for similar game-plus-bike vibes. A comfortable steering input method was never worked out, and handlebar-button steering was rejected out of concern it would build dangerous muscle memory on a real bike.
mentions.problem: No comfortable, non-awkward way of doing steering input for bike-controlled play was ever worked out.
mentions.audience: The author's own bike-controlled gaming experiments
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a half-built Eurotrucker mod somewhere for similar vibes. Never worked out a way of doing steering input that wasn't incredibly awkward, though.
mentions.author: gabriel666smith
